sentences.text: CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ---------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Mayank Mohit Sinha, Advocate For the State : Mr. A. P. Topno, A.P.P ---------
 th 04/Dated: 11 January, 2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant-husband, who is in custody since 07.06.2022, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T No.229 of 2022, arising out of Ramgarh P.S. Case No.137 of 2022, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge - I, Ramgarh.
3. It appears that the applicant has been made an accused for committing the offence under Sections 302/ 304-B/ 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

4. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that two witnesses have already been examined and they have been Binod Kumar @ Binod Rawani vs The State Of Jharkhand .....

On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the materials available on record and the stage of trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.

Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant is, hereby,
rejected.

7. However, the trial court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude it as early as possible,
preferably within six months from the date of receipt/ production of copy of this order.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Chandan/-
